assessment.defect: DecideRelayRequest converted sql.ErrNoRows from guarded UPDATE RETURNING to nil inside inWriteTx. That instructed the helper to attempt COMMIT for a transaction with no matched verdict. Deadline expiry during that unnecessary COMMIT was correctly classified unconfirmed by the helper but prevented the caller from naming the known guarded refusal.
assessment.fix: Return sql.ErrNoRows from the callback, invoking existing precommit rollback/quarantine cleanup. After the helper, convert the no-match sentinel to (false,nil) only if the helper did not also classify precommit context expiry as ErrStoreBusy. There is no COMMIT attempt for a successful no-match observation. The API performs its existing follow-up reads and legacy settling refusal.
assessment.safety: No earlier API refusal based on a stale read. Guarded UPDATE, BEGIN IMMEDIATE and first-writer atomicity are unchanged. The zero-row path never sets written or emits a committed mutation. Existing rollback/restoration and expired-disposal quarantine remain authoritative. A matched UPDATE still reaches the same COMMIT; every possibly written COMMIT error remains internal unconfirmed. A precommit expired callback keeps ErrStoreBusy, with the original underlying error.
assessment.scope: No helper-wide speculative error reclassification, deadline enlargement, reduced parallelism, assertion weakening, SQL guard change, public signature/schema/model change or fixture distortion.

technical_decision_for_srd: A guarded decision UPDATE that returns no row is a precommit no-match outcome: roll its transaction back rather than COMMIT. Return false,nil to allow existing race-aware refusal classification when the callback/operation is still valid; retain helper ErrStoreBusy on precommit expiry. Only potentially applied verdicts attempt COMMIT and retain unconfirmed-outcome handling on COMMIT error.
